//: Preventive indexing/watcher limits. The 2026-08-19 out-of-memory crash was traced to the Roblox Studio MCP proxy (unbounded logging of base64 screenshots, ignored stdin backpressure, orphaned child processes), NOT to workspace indexing -- this project is 266 files and 64MB. These exclusions exist so the tree stays cheap to index as .rbxl place files, build output and vendored packages appear later.
//luau: Luau LSP is scoped to the Rojo-managed source tree. src/ and tests/ are the only directories holding .luau modules; tools/ is Node scripts and .brain/ is markdown governance.
//size: Files above this size are not tokenized for editor features. Guards against a large generated or vendored file being parsed on every keystroke.
//encoding: The repo is committed with LF (see .gitattributes); keep the editor from reintroducing CRLF churn.
